#creating the data.soft again
```{r}
Data <- read.csv(file = "clinical.csv", dec = ".", sep = ";")



dim(Data)
Data.soft <- Data[, c(7,9,  12:17, 20, 21, 24:26, 38, 40, 42, 50,52,57,64,65,66,67, 71:74, 78, 81, 82)]
dim(Data.soft)
Data.soft <- Data.soft[
  complete.cases(Data.soft[, -c(1, 2), drop = FALSE]),
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

dim(Data.soft)

 
# Normalising
Data.soft_subset <- Data.soft[
  , !names(Data.soft) %in% c(
    "u3n_prot_OmicEra_ff4",
    "u3n_metabBiocrP500_ff4",
    "u3csex",
    "u3twhratc",
    "u3tdm110y15",
    "u3tbmiwho",
    "u3twhoish",
    "u3tmsidfup"
  )
]

numeric_cols <- names(Data.soft_subset)[
  sapply(Data.soft_subset, is.numeric)
] # Get names of numeric columns

dim(Data.soft_subset)

#### Apply the transformation to each numeric column in the original Data.soft and then viewing the data 

Data.soft[numeric_cols] <- lapply(Data.soft[numeric_cols], function(col) { 
  qnorm((rank(col, na.last = "keep") - 0.5) / sum(!is.na(col)))
})

Data.soft.Metabolic <- Data.soft[Data.soft$u3tmsidfup == 1,]
Data.soft.Metabolic <- subset(
  Data.soft,
  u3tmsidfup == 1,
  select = -u3tmsidfup
)
dim(Data.soft.Metabolic)

save(Data.soft.Metabolic, file = "Data.soft.Metabolic.RData")
getwd()
```

#extracting assignments 
```{r}
a2_M <- as.robust.Metabolic[[2]]  # Extract archetype model for k = 2
a3_M <- as.robust.Metabolic[[3]]  # Extract archetype model for k = 3
a4_M <- as.robust.Metabolic[[4]]  # Extract archetype model for k = 4
a5_M <- as.robust.Metabolic[[5]]  # Extract archetype model for k = 5
a6_M <- as.robust.Metabolic[[6]]  # Extract archetype model for k = 6


# If you want to inspect the alphas (archetype assignments)
assignments_a2_M <- bestModel(a2_M)$alphas
assignments_a3_M <- bestModel(a3_M)$alphas
assignments_a4_M <- bestModel(a4_M)$alphas
assignments_a5_M <- bestModel(a5_M)$alphas
assignments_a6_M <- bestModel(a6_M)$alphas
```


#Assigning each person of MetS to different archetypes after deciding the best numbers of archetypes
```{r}
#chang the assignements
# Get the indices of extreme archetypes
Extreme.archetype_indices <- which(assignments_a3_M > 0.7, arr.ind = TRUE)  # Get indices of extreme archetypes with #information about the row and coloms 
Extreme.archetype_indices
Participants.number <- Extreme.archetype_indices[,c(1,2)]

Participants.number <- data.frame(Participant_Number = Participants.number[, 1],
                                  Archetype_Number = Participants.number[, 2])
Participants.number

# Initialize Extreme_Archetype_Number with NA
Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number <- NA  

# Populate Extreme_Archetype_Number for extreme participants
for (i in 1:nrow(Participants.number)) {
  participant_id <- Participants.number$Participant_Number[i]
  archetype_id <- Participants.number$Archetype_Number[i]
  
  # Assign the archetype number to the corresponding participant in Data.soft
  Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[participant_id] <- archetype_id
}

mixed_etiology <- which(apply(assignments_a3_M, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.7)))#change the assignment

# Assign a specific value for mixed etiology participants in Extreme_Archetype_Number
Data.soft.Metabolic$Extreme_Archetype_Number[mixed_etiology] <- "Mixed Etiology"  # You can change this label as needed
```

#diving in to the mixed etiology
```{r}
# Subset alphas for mixed etiology individuals
mixed_scores <- bestModel(a3_M)$alphas[mixed_etiology,]

# Identify the highest and second highest archetype memberships
archetype_labels <- c("M1", "M2", "M3")
highest_archetypes <- apply(mixed_scores, 1, function(x) order(x, decreasing = TRUE)[1])

second_highest_archetypes <- apply(mixed_scores, 1, function(x) order(x, decreasing = TRUE)[2])

highest_labels <- archetype_labels[highest_archetypes]
second_highest_labels <- archetype_labels[second_highest_archetypes]

# Combine primary and secondary archetypes into a group
mixed_groups <- paste0(highest_labels, ",", second_highest_labels)
Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group <- NA
Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group[mixed_etiology] <- mixed_groups

# Create a data frame to hold the results
mixed <- data.frame(
  Participant = mixed_etiology,
  Highest_Archetype = highest_archetypes,
  Second_Highest_Archetype = second_highest_archetypes
)

mixed
mixed_scores
single_dominating <- apply(mixed_scores, 1, function(x) sum(x >= 0.4) == 1)
two_dominating <- apply(mixed_scores, 1, function(x) sum(x >= 0.4) == 2)
no_dominating <- apply(mixed_scores, 1, function(x) all(x < 0.4))

# Count participants in each category
count_single_dominating <- sum(single_dominating)
count_two_dominating <- sum(two_dominating)
count_no_dominating <- sum(no_dominating)

print(count_single_dominating)
print(count_two_dominating)
print(count_no_dominating)
mixed_groups <- paste0(highest_labels, second_highest_labels)
table(mixed_groups)

Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group <- NA
Data.soft.Metabolic$Mixed_Group[mixed_etiology] <- mixed_groups
```

```{r}
library(pheatmap)

# ============================================================
# ============================================================

mixed_label <- as.character(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group
)

# Convert blank values or text "NA" to actual NA
mixed_label[
  trimws(mixed_label) %in% c("", "NA")
] <- NA_character_

extreme_number <- as.character(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Extreme_Archetype_Number
)
extreme_label <- ifelse(
  grepl("^[0-9]+$", extreme_number),
  paste0("M", extreme_number),
  NA_character_
)

# Use Mixed_Group when available; otherwise use the extreme label
New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group <- ifelse(
  !is.na(mixed_label),
  mixed_label,
  extreme_label
)

New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group <- factor(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group
)

# Check group sizes
table(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

first_metabolite <- match(
  "C0",
  names(New_merged_metabolomics)
)

last_metabolite <- match(
  "Choline",
  names(New_merged_metabolomics)
)

# Stop if the metabolite columns cannot be found
if (
  is.na(first_metabolite) ||
  is.na(last_metabolite)
) {
  stop("C0 or Choline could not be found in the dataset.")
}

metabolite_vars <- names(New_merged_metabolomics)[
  first_metabolite:last_metabolite
]

length(metabolite_vars)
head(metabolite_vars)
tail(metabolite_vars)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

comparison_groups <- levels(
  droplevels(
    New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group
  )
)

comparison_groups


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

test_estimates <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(metabolite_vars),
  ncol = length(comparison_groups),
  dimnames = list(
    metabolite_vars,
    comparison_groups
  )
)

standard_errors <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(metabolite_vars),
  ncol = length(comparison_groups),
  dimnames = list(
    metabolite_vars,
    comparison_groups
  )
)

p_values <- matrix(
  NA_real_,
  nrow = length(metabolite_vars),
  ncol = length(comparison_groups),
  dimnames = list(
    metabolite_vars,
    comparison_groups
  )
)

n_group <- matrix(
  NA_integer_,
  nrow = length(metabolite_vars),
  ncol = length(comparison_groups),
  dimnames = list(
    metabolite_vars,
    comparison_groups
  )
)

n_rest <- matrix(
  NA_integer_,
  nrow = length(metabolite_vars),
  ncol = length(comparison_groups),
  dimnames = list(
    metabolite_vars,
    comparison_groups
  )
)


# ============================================================
#
# Model:
# Metabolite ~ group versus rest + age + sex
# ============================================================

for (group in comparison_groups) {

  for (metabolite in metabolite_vars) {

    model_data <- data.frame(
      Outcome = New_merged_metabolomics[[metabolite]],

      Comparison_Group =
        New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group,

      Age =
        New_merged_metabolomics$u3talteru,

      Sex =
        New_merged_metabolomics$u3csex
    )

    # Remove rows missing the metabolite, group, age, or sex
    model_data <- model_data[
      complete.cases(model_data),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    # Create binary variable:
    model_data$Group_indicator <- as.integer(
      model_data$Comparison_Group == group
    )

    model_data$Sex <- factor(
      model_data$Sex
    )

    number_in_group <- sum(
      model_data$Group_indicator == 1
    )

    number_in_rest <- sum(
      model_data$Group_indicator == 0
    )

    n_group[metabolite, group] <-
      number_in_group

    n_rest[metabolite, group] <-
      number_in_rest

    # Run only when both comparison groups contain enough participants
    if (
      number_in_group > 2 &&
      number_in_rest > 2
    ) {

      model <- tryCatch(
        lm(
          Outcome ~
            Group_indicator +
            Age +
            Sex,
          data = model_data
        ),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )

      if (!is.null(model)) {

        model_summary <- coef(
          summary(model)
        )

        if (
          "Group_indicator" %in%
            rownames(model_summary)
        ) {

          test_estimates[metabolite, group] <-
            model_summary[
              "Group_indicator",
              "Estimate"
            ]

          standard_errors[metabolite, group] <-
            model_summary[
              "Group_indicator",
              "Std. Error"
            ]

          p_values[metabolite, group] <-
            model_summary[
              "Group_indicator",
              "Pr(>|t|)"
            ]
        }
      }
    }
  }
}


# ============================================================
#
# FDR is calculated across all metabolites separately
# for each group-versus-rest comparison.
# ============================================================

adjusted_p_values <- apply(
  p_values,
  2,
  function(x) {
    p.adjust(
      x,
      method = "fdr"
    )
  }
)

# Restore matrix dimensions if needed
adjusted_p_values <- matrix(
  adjusted_p_values,
  nrow = nrow(p_values),
  ncol = ncol(p_values),
  dimnames = dimnames(p_values)
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

get_significance <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  }

  if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  }

  if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }

  return("")
}

significance <- matrix(
  vapply(
    as.vector(adjusted_p_values),
    get_significance,
    character(1)
  ),
  nrow = nrow(adjusted_p_values),
  ncol = ncol(adjusted_p_values),
  dimnames = dimnames(adjusted_p_values)
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

metabolite_regression_results <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = rep(
    rownames(test_estimates),
    times = ncol(test_estimates)
  ),

  Comparison = rep(
    colnames(test_estimates),
    each = nrow(test_estimates)
  ),

  Estimate = as.vector(
    test_estimates
  ),

  Standard_Error = as.vector(
    standard_errors
  ),

  P_value = as.vector(
    p_values
  ),

  FDR = as.vector(
    adjusted_p_values
  ),

  N_group = as.vector(
    n_group
  ),

  N_rest = as.vector(
    n_rest
  )
)

# Sort by FDR
metabolite_regression_results <-
  metabolite_regression_results[
    order(
      metabolite_regression_results$FDR
    ),
  ]

head(metabolite_regression_results)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

significant_metabolite_results <-
  metabolite_regression_results[
    !is.na(
      metabolite_regression_results$FDR
    ) &
      metabolite_regression_results$FDR < 0.05,
  ]

dim(significant_metabolite_results)

head(significant_metabolite_results)


# Save complete results
write.csv(
  metabolite_regression_results,
  file =
    "Metabolite_Extreme_Mixed_Group_Regression_Results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)

# Save significant results
write.csv(
  significant_metabolite_results,
  file =
    "Significant_Metabolite_Extreme_Mixed_Group_Results.csv",
  row.names = FALSE
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

significant_metabolites <- apply(
  adjusted_p_values,
  1,
  function(x) {
    any(
      x < 0.05,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  }
)

sum(significant_metabolites)

heatmap_estimates <- test_estimates[
  significant_metabolites,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]

heatmap_significance <- significance[
  significant_metabolites,
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (nrow(heatmap_estimates) > 0) {

  my_palette <- colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "blue",
      "white",
      "red"
    )
  )(50)

  png(
    filename =
      "Heatmap_Extreme_and_Mixed_Groups_Metabolomics_fdr.png",
    width = 12,
    height = max(
      8,
      nrow(heatmap_estimates) * 0.22
    ),
    units = "in",
    res = 600
  )

  pheatmap(
    heatmap_estimates,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,

    # Standardizes regression estimates across groups
    # separately for each metabolite
    scale = "row",

    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,

    display_numbers =
      heatmap_significance,

    number_color = "black",

    color = my_palette,

    angle_col = "0",

    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 11,

    border_color = NA,

    main =
      "Metabolite Profiles of Extreme and Mixed Etiology Groups"
  )

  dev.off()

} else {

  message(
    "No metabolites were significant after FDR correction."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

getwd()
```

#comparison between the mixed groups togther
```{r}
# ============================================================
# Pairwise metabolite comparisons between mixed groups only
# Linear regression adjusted for age and sex
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(emmeans)
library(pheatmap)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

mixed_groups <- c(
  "M1M2",
  "M1M3",
  "M2M1",
  "M2M3",
  "M3M1",
  "M3M2"
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group <- as.character(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group
)

New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group[
  trimws(New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group) %in%
    c("", "NA")
] <- NA_character_


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

Mixed_metabolomics_data <-
  New_merged_metabolomics[
    New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group %in% mixed_groups,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

Mixed_metabolomics_data$Comparison_Group <- factor(
  Mixed_metabolomics_data$Mixed_Group,
  levels = mixed_groups
)

Mixed_metabolomics_data$u3csex <- factor(
  Mixed_metabolomics_data$u3csex
)

# Check group sizes
table(
  Mixed_metabolomics_data$Comparison_Group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

dim(Mixed_metabolomics_data)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

first_metabolite <- match(
  "C0",
  names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)
)

last_metabolite <- match(
  "Choline",
  names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)
)

if (
  is.na(first_metabolite) ||
  is.na(last_metabolite)
) {
  stop(
    "The metabolite columns C0 or Choline could not be found."
  )
}

metabolite_vars <- names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)[
  first_metabolite:last_metabolite
]

# Keep numeric metabolites only
metabolite_vars <- metabolite_vars[
  vapply(
    Mixed_metabolomics_data[metabolite_vars],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]

length(metabolite_vars)
head(metabolite_vars)
tail(metabolite_vars)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (exists("pairwise_metabolite_results")) {
  rm(pairwise_metabolite_results)
}

model_errors <- list()


# ============================================================
#
# Model:
# Metabolite ~ Mixed group + Age + Sex
# ============================================================

pairwise_metabolite_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  metabolite_vars,
  function(metabolite) {

    model_data <- data.frame(
      Outcome =
        Mixed_metabolomics_data[[metabolite]],

      Comparison_Group =
        Mixed_metabolomics_data$Comparison_Group,

      Age =
        Mixed_metabolomics_data$u3talteru,

      Sex =
        Mixed_metabolomics_data$u3csex
    )

    # Remove missing observations
    model_data <- model_data[
      stats::complete.cases(model_data),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    model_data$Comparison_Group <- droplevels(
      factor(model_data$Comparison_Group)
    )

    model_data$Sex <- droplevels(
      factor(model_data$Sex)
    )

    # Skip if fewer than two groups remain
    if (nlevels(model_data$Comparison_Group) < 2) {

      model_errors[[metabolite]] <<-
        "Fewer than two mixed groups remained."

      return(NULL)
    }

    # Skip if only one sex category remains
    if (nlevels(model_data$Sex) < 2) {

      model_errors[[metabolite]] <<-
        "Only one sex category remained."

      return(NULL)
    }

    # Skip if the metabolite has no variation
    if (
      length(unique(model_data$Outcome)) < 2 ||
      is.na(stats::sd(model_data$Outcome)) ||
      stats::sd(model_data$Outcome) == 0
    ) {

      model_errors[[metabolite]] <<-
        "The metabolite had no variation."

      return(NULL)
    }

    # Fit linear regression
    model <- tryCatch(
      stats::lm(
        Outcome ~ Comparison_Group + Age + Sex,
        data = model_data
      ),
      error = function(e) {

        model_errors[[metabolite]] <<- paste(
          "Linear-model error:",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(model)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    # Calculate adjusted means for the mixed groups
    estimated_means <- tryCatch(
      emmeans::emmeans(
        model,
        specs = "Comparison_Group"
      ),
      error = function(e) {

        model_errors[[metabolite]] <<- paste(
          "emmeans error:",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (is.null(estimated_means)) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    # All direct pairwise comparisons
    pairwise_results <- tryCatch(
      as.data.frame(
        emmeans::contrast(
          estimated_means,
          method = "pairwise",
          adjust = "none"
        )
      ),
      error = function(e) {

        model_errors[[metabolite]] <<- paste(
          "Pairwise-contrast error:",
          conditionMessage(e)
        )

        return(NULL)
      }
    )

    if (
      is.null(pairwise_results) ||
      nrow(pairwise_results) == 0
    ) {
      return(NULL)
    }

    pairwise_results |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        Metabolite = metabolite,
        N = stats::nobs(model)
      )
  }
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (
  is.null(pairwise_metabolite_results) ||
  nrow(pairwise_metabolite_results) == 0
) {

  print(
    utils::head(
      model_errors,
      20
    )
  )

  stop(
    paste(

get_significance <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  }

  if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  }

  if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }

  return("")
}


pairwise_metabolite_results <-
  pairwise_metabolite_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significance = vapply(
      FDR,
      get_significance,
      character(1)
    )
  )


# ============================================================
# one comparison
# ============================================================

significant_metabolite_names <-
  pairwise_metabolite_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(FDR),
    FDR < 0.05
  ) |>
  dplyr::distinct(
    Metabolite
  ) |>
  dplyr::pull(
    Metabolite
  )

length(significant_metabolite_names)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (
  length(significant_metabolite_names) > 0
) {

  # Regression-estimate matrix
  estimate_data <-
    pairwise_metabolite_results |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Metabolite %in%
        significant_metabolite_names
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Metabolite,
      Comparison,
      estimate
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = estimate
    )

  estimate_matrix <- as.data.frame(
    estimate_data
  )

  rownames(estimate_matrix) <-
    estimate_matrix$Metabolite

  estimate_matrix$Metabolite <- NULL

  estimate_matrix <- as.matrix(
    estimate_matrix
  )


  # Significance-star matrix
  significance_data <-
    pairwise_metabolite_results |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Metabolite %in%
        significant_metabolite_names
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Metabolite,
      Comparison,
      Significance
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = Significance,
      values_fill = ""
    )

  significance_matrix <- as.data.frame(
    significance_data
  )

  rownames(significance_matrix) <-
    significance_matrix$Metabolite

  significance_matrix$Metabolite <- NULL

  significance_matrix <- as.matrix(
    significance_matrix
  )

  # Ensure matching rows and columns
  significance_matrix <-
    significance_matrix[
      rownames(estimate_matrix),
      colnames(estimate_matrix),
      drop = FALSE
    ]


  # ==========================================================
  # ==========================================================

  my_palette <- colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "blue",
      "white",
      "red"
    )
  )(50)

  grDevices::png(
    filename =
      "Heatmap_Mixed_Group_Pairwise_Metabolite_Comparisons.png",
    width = 16,
    height = max(
      8,
      nrow(estimate_matrix) * 0.22
    ),
    units = "in",
    res = 600
  )

  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    estimate_matrix,

    cluster_rows =
      nrow(estimate_matrix) > 1,

    cluster_cols = FALSE,

    scale = "row",

    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,

    display_numbers =
      significance_matrix,

    number_color = "black",

    color = my_palette,

    angle_col = "45",

    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 8,

    border_color = NA,

    main =
      "Pairwise Metabolite Comparisons Between Mixed Etiology Groups"
  )

  grDevices::dev.off()

} else {

  message(
    "No metabolites were significant after FDR correction."
  )
}
```

#comparison using the nonparametric test 

```{r}
# ============================================================
# Pairwise Wilcoxon comparisons between mixed groups
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(purrr)
library(tidyr)
library(pheatmap)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

mixed_groups <- c(
  "M1M2",
  "M1M3",
  "M2M1",
  "M2M3",
  "M3M1",
  "M3M2"
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group <- as.character(
  New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group
)

# Convert blank values and character "NA" to actual NA
New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group[
  trimws(New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group) %in%
    c("", "NA")
] <- NA_character_


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

Mixed_metabolomics_data <-
  New_merged_metabolomics[
    New_merged_metabolomics$Mixed_Group %in% mixed_groups,
    ,
    drop = FALSE
  ]

Mixed_metabolomics_data$Mixed_Group <- factor(
  Mixed_metabolomics_data$Mixed_Group,
  levels = mixed_groups
)

# Check sample sizes
table(
  Mixed_metabolomics_data$Mixed_Group,
  useNA = "ifany"
)

dim(Mixed_metabolomics_data)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

first_metabolite <- match(
  "C0",
  names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)
)

last_metabolite <- match(
  "Choline",
  names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)
)

if (
  is.na(first_metabolite) ||
  is.na(last_metabolite)
) {
  stop(
    "The metabolite columns C0 or Choline could not be found."
  )
}

metabolite_vars <- names(Mixed_metabolomics_data)[
  first_metabolite:last_metabolite
]

# Retain numeric metabolites only
metabolite_vars <- metabolite_vars[
  vapply(
    Mixed_metabolomics_data[metabolite_vars],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)
  )
]

length(metabolite_vars)
head(metabolite_vars)
tail(metabolite_vars)


# ============================================================
#
# ============================================================

pairwise_group_list <- utils::combn(
  mixed_groups,
  2,
  simplify = FALSE
)

pairwise_group_list


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

pairwise_wilcoxon_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  metabolite_vars,
  function(metabolite) {

    metabolite_data <- data.frame(
      Value = Mixed_metabolomics_data[[metabolite]],
      Group = Mixed_metabolomics_data$Mixed_Group
    )

    # Remove missing metabolite and group values
    metabolite_data <- metabolite_data[
      stats::complete.cases(metabolite_data),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    purrr::map_dfr(
      pairwise_group_list,
      function(group_pair) {

        group1_name <- group_pair[1]
        group2_name <- group_pair[2]

        group1_values <- metabolite_data$Value[
          metabolite_data$Group == group1_name
        ]

        group2_values <- metabolite_data$Value[
          metabolite_data$Group == group2_name
        ]

        # Require at least three observations in each group
        if (
          length(group1_values) < 3 ||
          length(group2_values) < 3
        ) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        test_result <- tryCatch(
          stats::wilcox.test(
            x = group1_values,
            y = group2_values,
            alternative = "two.sided",
            exact = FALSE,
            paired = FALSE
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            NULL
          }
        )

        if (is.null(test_result)) {
          return(NULL)
        }

        median_group1 <- stats::median(
          group1_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        median_group2 <- stats::median(
          group2_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        data.frame(
          Metabolite = metabolite,

          Group1 = group1_name,

          Group2 = group2_name,

          Comparison = paste0(
            group1_name,
            "_vs_",
            group2_name
          ),

          N_Group1 = length(group1_values),

          N_Group2 = length(group2_values),

          Median_Group1 = median_group1,

          Median_Group2 = median_group2,

          Median_Difference =
            median_group1 - median_group2,

          Wilcoxon_W =
            unname(test_result$statistic),

          P_value =
            test_result$p.value
        )
      }
    )
  }
)


# Check results
dim(pairwise_wilcoxon_results)

head(pairwise_wilcoxon_results)

unique(
  pairwise_wilcoxon_results$Comparison
)


# ============================================================
#
# FDR is calculated across metabolites separately for each
# pairwise comparison.
# ============================================================

pairwise_wilcoxon_results <-
  pairwise_wilcoxon_results |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Comparison
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    FDR = stats::p.adjust(
      P_value,
      method = "fdr"
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup() |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Comparison,
    FDR
  )


# Check corrected results

  )

get_significance <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  }

  if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  }

  if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }

  return("")
}

    Significance = vapply(

      get_significance,
      character(1)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================

find_writable_output_dir <- function() {

  user_profile <- Sys.getenv("USERPROFILE")

  candidate_directories <- unique(
    c(
      file.path(
        user_profile,
        "Documents",
        "Proteomics_Wilcoxon_Results"
      ),
      file.path(
        getwd(),
        "Proteomics_Wilcoxon_Results"
      ),
      file.path(
        tempdir(),
        "Proteomics_Wilcoxon_Results"
      )
    )
  )

  for (directory in candidate_directories) {

    try(
      dir.create(
        directory,
        recursive = TRUE,
        showWarnings = FALSE
      ),
      silent = TRUE
    )

    test_file <- file.path(
      directory,
      paste0(
        ".write_test_",
        Sys.getpid(),
        ".tmp"
      )
    )

    writable <- tryCatch(
      {
        created <- suppressWarnings(
          file.create(test_file)
        )

        if (isTRUE(created)) {
          unlink(test_file)
          TRUE
        } else {
          FALSE
        }
      },
      error = function(e) {
        FALSE
      }
    )

    if (writable) {
      return(
        normalizePath(
          directory,
          winslash = "/",
          mustWork = TRUE
        )
      )
    }
  }

  stop(
    "R could not find or create a writable output directory."
  )
}


output_dir <- find_writable_output_dir()

# Helper function for creating output paths
output_path <- function(file_name) {

  extension <- tools::file_ext(file_name)

  base_name <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    file_name
  )

  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(
      base_name,
      "_",
      run_timestamp,
      ".",
      extension
    )
  )
}

pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  protein_vars,
  function(protein) {

    protein_data <- data.frame(
      Value =
        Extreme_mixed_proteomics_data[[protein]],

      Group =
        Extreme_mixed_proteomics_data$Comparison_Group
    )

    # Remove missing protein values and missing group labels
    protein_data <- protein_data[
      stats::complete.cases(protein_data),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]

    protein_data$Group <- droplevels(
      protein_data$Group
    )


    purrr::map_dfr(
      pairwise_group_list,
      function(group_pair) {

        group1_name <- group_pair[1]
        group2_name <- group_pair[2]

        group1_values <- protein_data$Value[
          protein_data$Group == group1_name
        ]

        group2_values <- protein_data$Value[
          protein_data$Group == group2_name
        ]


        # Require at least three observations per group
        if (
          length(group1_values) < 3 ||
          length(group2_values) < 3
        ) {
          return(NULL)
        }


        # Skip proteins with no variation across the two groups
        if (
          length(
            unique(
              c(
                group1_values,
                group2_values
              )
            )
          ) < 2
        ) {
          return(NULL)
        }


        test_result <- tryCatch(
          stats::wilcox.test(
            x = group1_values,
            y = group2_values,
            alternative = "two.sided",
            paired = FALSE,
            exact = FALSE
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            NULL
          }
        )


        if (is.null(test_result)) {
          return(NULL)
        }


        median_group1 <- stats::median(
          group1_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        median_group2 <- stats::median(
          group2_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )


        data.frame(
          Protein = protein,

          Group1 = group1_name,

          Group2 = group2_name,

          Comparison = paste0(
            group1_name,
            "_vs_",
            group2_name
          ),

          N_Group1 =
            length(group1_values),

          N_Group2 =
            length(group2_values),

          Median_Group1 =
            median_group1,

          Median_Group2 =
            median_group2,

          Median_Difference =
            median_group1 - median_group2,

          Wilcoxon_W =
            unname(test_result$statistic),

          P_value =
            test_result$p.value,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

get_significance <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  } else if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  } else if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  } else if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  } else {
    return("")
  }
}


pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results <-
  pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Significance = vapply(
      FDR,
      get_significance,
      character(1)
    )
  )

  pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results |>
  dplyr::group_by(
    Protein
  ) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    Minimum_FDR = suppressWarnings(
      min(
        FDR,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Minimum_FDR = ifelse(
      is.infinite(Minimum_FDR),
      NA_real_,
      Minimum_FDR
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::filter(
    !is.na(Minimum_FDR),
    Minimum_FDR < 0.05
  ) |>
  dplyr::arrange(
    Minimum_FDR
  )

  ranked_significant_proteins$Protein,
  max_heatmap_proteins
)

length(
  heatmap_protein_names
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (length(heatmap_protein_names) > 0) {

  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Median-difference matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  median_difference_data <-
    pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Protein %in% heatmap_protein_names
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Protein,
      Comparison,
      Median_Difference
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = Median_Difference
    )


  median_difference_matrix <- as.data.frame(
    median_difference_data
  )

  rownames(median_difference_matrix) <-
    median_difference_matrix$Protein

  median_difference_matrix$Protein <- NULL

  median_difference_matrix <- as.matrix(
    median_difference_matrix
  )


  # Order proteins according to minimum FDR
  desired_row_order <- heatmap_protein_names[
    heatmap_protein_names %in%
      rownames(median_difference_matrix)
  ]

  median_difference_matrix <-
    median_difference_matrix[
      desired_row_order,
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significance-star matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  significance_data <-
    pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Protein %in% heatmap_protein_names
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Protein,
      Comparison,
      Significance
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = Significance,
      values_fill = ""
    )


  significance_matrix <- as.data.frame(
    significance_data
  )

  rownames(significance_matrix) <-
    significance_matrix$Protein

  significance_matrix$Protein <- NULL

  significance_matrix <- as.matrix(
    significance_matrix
  )


  # Match rows and columns between matrices
  significance_matrix <-
    significance_matrix[
      rownames(median_difference_matrix),
      colnames(median_difference_matrix),
      drop = FALSE
    ]


  # ==========================================================
  #
  # Example:
  # ==========================================================

  protein_short_names <- sub(
    pattern = "^(?:sp|tr)_[^_]+_([^_]+)_.*$",
    replacement = "\\1",
    x = rownames(median_difference_matrix),
    perl = TRUE
  )


  # Check the conversion
  protein_name_mapping <- data.frame(
    Full_name =
      rownames(median_difference_matrix),

    Short_name =
      protein_short_names,

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  head(
    protein_name_mapping,
    20
  )


  protein_mapping_file <- output_path(
    "Protein_Full_and_Short_Name_Mapping.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    protein_name_mapping,
    file = protein_mapping_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # ==========================================================

  maximum_absolute_difference <- suppressWarnings(
    max(
      abs(median_difference_matrix),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )


  if (
    !is.finite(maximum_absolute_difference) ||
    maximum_absolute_difference == 0
  ) {
    maximum_absolute_difference <- 1
  }


  my_palette <- colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "blue",
      "white",
      "red"
    )
  )(50)


  heatmap_breaks <- seq(
    -maximum_absolute_difference,
    maximum_absolute_difference,
    length.out = 51
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # ==========================================================

  graphics.off()


  heatmap_height <- min(
    max(
      8,
      nrow(median_difference_matrix) * 0.18
    ),
    30
  )


  heatmap_file <- output_path(
    "Heatmap_Pairwise_Wilcoxon_Extreme_and_Mixed_Proteomics.pdf"
  )


  grDevices::pdf(
    file = heatmap_file,
    width = 22,
    height = heatmap_height,
    onefile = FALSE
  )


  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    median_difference_matrix,

    cluster_rows =
      nrow(median_difference_matrix) > 1 &&
      !anyNA(median_difference_matrix),

    cluster_cols = FALSE,

    scale = "none",

    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,

    # Display short protein names such as APOF
    labels_row =
      protein_short_names,

    display_numbers =
      significance_matrix,

    number_color = "black",

    color = my_palette,

    breaks = heatmap_breaks,

    angle_col = "90",

    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 6,

    border_color = NA,

    na_col = "grey90",

    main =
      "Pairwise Wilcoxon Comparisons of Proteins Between Extreme and Mixed Groups"
  )


  grDevices::dev.off()


} else {

  message(
    "No proteins were significant after FDR correction."
  )
}
```

```{r}
      drop = FALSE
    ]


  # ----------------------------------------------------------
  # Significance-star matrix
  # ----------------------------------------------------------

  significance_data <-
    pairwise_protein_wilcoxon_results |>
    dplyr::filter(
      Protein %in% heatmap_protein_names
    ) |>
    dplyr::select(
      Protein,
      Comparison,
      Significance
    ) |>
    tidyr::pivot_wider(
      names_from = Comparison,
      values_from = Significance,
      values_fill = ""
    )

  significance_matrix <- as.data.frame(
    significance_data
  )

  rownames(significance_matrix) <-
    significance_matrix$Protein

  significance_matrix$Protein <- NULL

  significance_matrix <- as.matrix(
    significance_matrix
  )


  # Match the row and column order
  significance_matrix <-
    significance_matrix[
      rownames(median_difference_matrix),
      colnames(median_difference_matrix),
      drop = FALSE
    ]


  # ==========================================================
  #
  # Supported examples:
  #
  # All become APOF.
  # ==========================================================

  extract_protein_symbol <- function(protein_name) {

    vapply(
      protein_name,
      function(current_name) {

        # Remove surrounding backticks if present
        current_name <- gsub(
          "^`|`$",
          "",
          current_name
        )

        # Remove an optional X added by make.names()
        current_name <- sub(
          pattern = "^X(?=(sp|tr)[._|])",
          replacement = "",
          x = current_name,
          perl = TRUE,
          ignore.case = TRUE
        )

        # Split names using underscore, pipe or dot
        name_parts <- strsplit(
          current_name,
          split = "[_|.]"
        )[[1]]

        name_parts <- name_parts[
          nzchar(name_parts)
        ]

        # UniProt format:
        if (
          length(name_parts) >= 3 &&
          tolower(name_parts[1]) %in% c("sp", "tr")
        ) {
          return(name_parts[3])
        }

        # Keep original name when it does not follow
        # the expected UniProt format
        current_name
      },
      character(1)
    )
  }


  protein_short_names <- extract_protein_symbol(
    rownames(median_difference_matrix)
  )


  # Confirm that the number of labels is correct
  stopifnot(
    length(protein_short_names) ==
      nrow(median_difference_matrix)
  )


  # Check the conversion
  protein_name_mapping <- data.frame(
    Full_name =
      rownames(median_difference_matrix),

    Short_name =
      protein_short_names,

    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  print(
    head(
      protein_name_mapping,
      20
    )
  )


  protein_mapping_file <- output_path(
    "Protein_Full_and_Short_Name_Mapping.csv"
  )

  utils::write.csv(
    protein_name_mapping,
    file = protein_mapping_file,
    row.names = FALSE
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # ==========================================================

  maximum_absolute_difference <- suppressWarnings(
    max(
      abs(median_difference_matrix),
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
  )

  if (
    !is.finite(maximum_absolute_difference) ||
    maximum_absolute_difference == 0
  ) {
    maximum_absolute_difference <- 1
  }


  my_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
    c(
      "blue",
      "white",
      "red"
    )
  )(50)


  heatmap_breaks <- seq(
    -maximum_absolute_difference,
    maximum_absolute_difference,
    length.out = 51
  )


  # ==========================================================
  # ==========================================================

  graphics.off()


  heatmap_height <- min(
    max(
      8,
      nrow(median_difference_matrix) * 0.18
    ),
    30
  )


  heatmap_file <- output_path(
    "Heatmap_Pairwise_Wilcoxon_Extreme_and_Mixed_Proteomics.pdf"
  )


  grDevices::pdf(
    file = heatmap_file,
    width = 22,
    height = heatmap_height,
    onefile = FALSE
  )


  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = median_difference_matrix,

    cluster_rows =
      nrow(median_difference_matrix) > 1 &&
      !anyNA(median_difference_matrix),

    cluster_cols = FALSE,

    scale = "none",

    show_rownames = TRUE,
    show_colnames = TRUE,

    # This forces the displayed labels to be APOF, APOB, etc.
    labels_row = protein_short_names,

    display_numbers = significance_matrix,

    number_color = "black",

    color = my_palette,

    breaks = heatmap_breaks,

    angle_col = "90",

    fontsize_row = 7,
    fontsize_col = 6,

    border_color = NA,

    na_col = "grey90",

    main =
      "Pairwise Wilcoxon Comparisons of Proteins Between Extreme and Mixed Groups"
  )


  grDevices::dev.off()

  message(
    "Heatmap saved to: ",
    heatmap_file
  )

} else {

  message(
    "No proteins were significant after FDR correction."
  )
}


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\nResults were saved in:\n",
  output_dir,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(
  "Group sizes:\n",
  group_sizes_file,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(

  selected_proteins_file,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(

  all_results_file,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(

  significant_results_file,
  "\n\n"
)

cat(

  comparison_counts_file,
  "\n\n"
)

  cat(

  )
}

cat(

  ),

)

    full.names = TRUE
  )
)
```

#check the statistical power
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(pwr)
metabolomics_counts <- c(
  M1 = 21, M1M2 = 27, M1M3 = 35, 
  M2 = 16, M2M1 = 51, M2M3 = 22, 
  M3 = 32, M3M1 = 38, M3M2 = 19
)

proteomics_counts <- c(
  M1 = 45, M1M2 = 69, M1M3 = 82, 
  M2 = 35, M2M1 = 81, M2M3 = 49, 
  M3 = 63, M3M1 = 80, M3M2 = 45
)
generate_power_table <- function(group_counts) {
  groups <- names(group_counts)
  comparisons <- combn(groups, 2, simplify = FALSE)
  
  # Loop through comparisons and calculate power metrics
  map_dfr(comparisons, function(pair) {
    g1 <- pair[1]
    g2 <- pair[2]
    n1 <- group_counts[[g1]]
    n2 <- group_counts[[g2]]
    p_03 <- pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, d = 0.3, sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$power
    p_05 <- pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, d = 0.5, sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$power
    p_08 <- pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, d = 0.8, sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$power
    min_d <- pwr.t2n.test(n1 = n1, n2 = n2, power = 0.8, sig.level = 0.05, alternative = "two.sided")$d
    
    # Return a single row tibble
    tibble(
      Comparison = paste0(g1, "_vs_", g2),
      Group1 = g1,
      Group2 = g2,
      N_Group1 = n1,
      N_Group2 = n2,
      Power_d_0.3 = round(p_03, 3),
      Power_d_0.5 = round(p_05, 3),
      Power_d_0.8 = round(p_08, 3),
      Minimum_effect_for_80_percent_power = round(min_d, 3)
    )
  }) %>%
    # Sort the table so the most powerful comparisons are at the top
    arrange(desc(Power_d_0.5))
}
metabolomics_power <- generate_power_table(metabolomics_counts)
proteomics_power   <- generate_power_table(proteomics_counts)
print(metabolomics_power, n = 36)
print(proteomics_power, n = 36)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# ============================================================

output_dir <- paste0(

)

    paste(

    )

}

    )

  },
  error = function(e) {
    FALSE
  }
)


if (!write_test_success) {

      "R cannot write to the selected output folder.",

      sep = "\n"
    )
  )
}


# Add a timestamp to avoid overwriting files
# or conflicts with files open in Excel
run_timestamp <- format(
  Sys.time(),
  "%Y%m%d_%H%M%S"
)


# Function for constructing output filenames
output_path <- function(file_name) {

  file_extension <- tools::file_ext(
    file_name
  )

  file_base <- tools::file_path_sans_ext(
    file_name
  )

  file.path(
    output_dir,
    paste0(

      "_",
      run_timestamp,
      ".",
      file_extension
    )
  )
}

)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

all_groups <- c(
  "M1",
  "M1M2",

] <- NA_character_


# ============================================================

  )

# Convert extreme archetype numbers:

  ),

    "M",
    extreme_number
  ),
  NA_character_
)

# ============================================================

New_merged_metabolomics$Comparison_Group <- ifelse(

# Check sample sizes

  group_sizes

available_groups <- levels(
  group_vs_rest_data$Comparison_Group

  )

# Save group sample sizes

# ============================================================

first_metabolite <- match(
  "C0",
  names(group_vs_rest_data)
)

last_metabolite <- match(
  "Choline",
  names(group_vs_rest_data)
)


if (
  is.na(first_metabolite) ||
  is.na(last_metabolite)
) {
  stop(
    paste(
      "The metabolite columns could not be identified.",
      "Check that C0 and Choline exist in the dataset."
    )
  )
}


if (first_metabolite > last_metabolite) {
  stop(

  )
}


metabolite_vars <- names(
  group_vs_rest_data
)[
  first_metabolite:last_metabolite
]


# Retain only numeric metabolite columns
metabolite_vars <- metabolite_vars[
  vapply(
    group_vs_rest_data[
      metabolite_vars
    ],
    is.numeric,
    logical(1)

if (length(metabolite_vars) == 0) {

  ),

  row.names = FALSE

# ============================================================
# ============================================================

group_vs_rest_results <- purrr::map_dfr(
  metabolite_vars,
  function(metabolite) {

    metabolite_data <- data.frame(
      Value =
        group_vs_rest_data[[metabolite]],

      Group =
        group_vs_rest_data$Comparison_Group
    )


    # Remove missing groups and missing/non-finite values
    metabolite_data <- metabolite_data[
      !is.na(metabolite_data$Group) &
        is.finite(metabolite_data$Value),
      ,
      drop = FALSE
    ]


    metabolite_data$Group <- droplevels(
      metabolite_data$Group
    )


    purrr::map_dfr(
      available_groups,
      function(current_group) {

        # Values in the current group
        group1_values <- metabolite_data$Value[
          metabolite_data$Group == current_group
        ]


        # Values in all other eight groups combined
        group2_values <- metabolite_data$Value[
          metabolite_data$Group != current_group
        ]


        comparison_name <- paste0(
          current_group,
          "_vs_All_Other_Groups"
        )


        # Require at least three observations
        if (
          length(group1_values) < 3 ||
          length(group2_values) < 3
        ) {
          return(
            data.frame(
              Metabolite = metabolite,
              Group = current_group,
              Comparison = comparison_name,
              N_Group = length(group1_values),
              N_Other_Groups = length(group2_values),
              Median_Group = NA_real_,
              Median_Other_Groups = NA_real_,
              Median_Difference = NA_real_,
              Wilcoxon_W = NA_real_,
              P_value = NA_real_,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          )
        }


        median_group <- stats::median(
          group1_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )

        median_other_groups <- stats::median(
          group2_values,
          na.rm = TRUE
        )


        # Skip the test if there is no variation
        if (
          length(
            unique(
              c(
                group1_values,
                group2_values
              )
            )
          ) < 2
        ) {
          return(
            data.frame(
              Metabolite = metabolite,
              Group = current_group,
              Comparison = comparison_name,
              N_Group = length(group1_values),
              N_Other_Groups = length(group2_values),
              Median_Group = median_group,
              Median_Other_Groups = median_other_groups,
              Median_Difference =
                median_group -
                median_other_groups,
              Wilcoxon_W = NA_real_,
              P_value = NA_real_,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          )
        }


        test_result <- tryCatch(
          stats::wilcox.test(
            x = group1_values,
            y = group2_values,
            alternative = "two.sided",
            paired = FALSE,
            exact = FALSE
          ),
          error = function(e) {
            NULL
          }
        )


        if (is.null(test_result)) {
          return(
            data.frame(
              Metabolite = metabolite,
              Group = current_group,
              Comparison = comparison_name,
              N_Group = length(group1_values),
              N_Other_Groups = length(group2_values),
              Median_Group = median_group,
              Median_Other_Groups = median_other_groups,
              Median_Difference =
                median_group -
                median_other_groups,
              Wilcoxon_W = NA_real_,
              P_value = NA_real_,
              stringsAsFactors = FALSE
            )
          )
        }


        data.frame(
          Metabolite = metabolite,

          Group = current_group,

          Comparison = comparison_name,

          N_Group =
            length(group1_values),

          N_Other_Groups =
            length(group2_values),

          Median_Group =
            median_group,

          Median_Other_Groups =
            median_other_groups,

          Median_Difference =
            median_group -
            median_other_groups,

          Wilcoxon_W =
            unname(
              test_result$statistic
            ),

          P_value =
            test_result$p.value,

          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    )
  }
)

get_significance <- function(p) {

  if (is.na(p)) {
    return("")
  }

  if (p < 0.001) {
    return("***")
  }

  if (p < 0.01) {
    return("**")
  }

  if (p < 0.05) {
    return("*")
  }

  return("")
}


group_vs_rest_results <-
  group_vs_rest_results |>

# ============================================================
# ============================================================

all_results_file <- output_path(
  "Metabolite_Group_vs_All_Other_Groups_Wilcoxon_Results.csv"
)


significant_results_file <- output_path(
  "Significant_Metabolite_Group_vs_All_Other_Groups_Results.csv"

if (length(heatmap_metabolite_names) == 0) {

# Median-difference matrix
median_difference_data <-
  group_vs_rest_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Metabolite %in%
      heatmap_metabolite_names
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Metabolite,
    Group,
    Median_Difference
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = Median_Difference
  )


median_difference_matrix <- as.data.frame(
  median_difference_data
)


rownames(median_difference_matrix) <-
  median_difference_matrix$Metabolite


median_difference_matrix$Metabolite <- NULL


median_difference_matrix <- as.matrix(
  median_difference_matrix
)


# Order rows by minimum FDR
desired_row_order <- heatmap_metabolite_names[
  heatmap_metabolite_names %in%
    rownames(median_difference_matrix)
]


median_difference_matrix <-
  median_difference_matrix[
    desired_row_order,
    available_groups,
    drop = FALSE
  ]


# Significance-star matrix
significance_data <-
  group_vs_rest_results |>
  dplyr::filter(
    Metabolite %in%
      heatmap_metabolite_names
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    Metabolite,
    Group,
    Significance
  ) |>
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    names_from = Group,
    values_from = Significance,
    values_fill = ""
  )


significance_matrix <- as.data.frame(
  significance_data
)


rownames(significance_matrix) <-
  significance_matrix$Metabolite


significance_matrix$Metabolite <- NULL


significance_matrix <- as.matrix(
  significance_matrix
)


# Match the row and column order
significance_matrix <-
  significance_matrix[
    rownames(median_difference_matrix),
    colnames(median_difference_matrix),
    drop = FALSE
  ]


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

maximum_absolute_difference <- suppressWarnings(
  max(
    abs(median_difference_matrix),
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


if (
  !is.finite(maximum_absolute_difference) ||
  maximum_absolute_difference == 0
) {
  maximum_absolute_difference <- 1
}


my_palette <- grDevices::colorRampPalette(
  c(
    "blue",
    "white",
    "red"
  )
)(50)


heatmap_breaks <- seq(
  -maximum_absolute_difference,
  maximum_absolute_difference,
  length.out = 51
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

graphics.off()


heatmap_height <- min(
  max(
    8,
    nrow(median_difference_matrix) * 0.15
  ),
  30
)


heatmap_file <- output_path(
  "Heatmap_Metabolite_Group_vs_All_Other_Groups.pdf"
)


grDevices::pdf(
  file = heatmap_file,
  width = 12,
  height = heatmap_height,
  onefile = FALSE
)


pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = median_difference_matrix,

  cluster_rows =
    nrow(median_difference_matrix) > 1 &&
    !anyNA(median_difference_matrix),

  cluster_cols = FALSE,

  # Keep actual median differences
  scale = "none",

  show_rownames = TRUE,
  show_colnames = TRUE,

  # Stars are based on FDR
  display_numbers =
    significance_matrix,

  number_color = "black",

  color = my_palette,

  breaks = heatmap_breaks,

  angle_col = "0",

  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 10,

  border_color = NA,

  na_col = "grey90",

  main = heatmap_title
)


grDevices::dev.off()


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

cat(
  "\nAll results were saved in:\n",
  normalizePath(
    output_dir,
    winslash = "/",
    mustWork = FALSE
  ),
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Group sizes:\n",
  group_sizes_file,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Selected metabolite variables:\n",
  selected_metabolites_file,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Complete Wilcoxon results:\n",
  all_results_file,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Significant Wilcoxon results:\n",
  significant_results_file,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Significant metabolite counts:\n",
  significant_counts_file,
  "\n\n"
)


cat(
  "Heatmap:\n",
  heatmap_file,
  "\n\n"
)


print(
  list.files(
    output_dir,
    pattern = paste0(
      run_timestamp,
      "\\.(csv|pdf)$"
    ),
    full.names = TRUE
  )
)


# ============================================================
# ============================================================

if (
  interactive() &&
  .Platform$OS.type == "windows"
) {

  shell.exec(
    normalizePath(
      output_dir,
      winslash = "\\",
      mustWork = TRUE
    )
  )

  if (file.exists(heatmap_file)) {

    shell.exec(
      normalizePath(
        heatmap_file,
        winslash = "\\",
        mustWork = TRUE
      )
    )
  }
}
```
